items.title: Meta Ads spend 2026-08-12: $51.03, 5 leads, CPL $10.21
items.summary: One active campaign, "Flooring Problems Campaign," accounted for all spend and leads yesterday: $51.03 across 1,380 impressions / 41 clicks, producing 5 leads at ~$10.21 CPL. That's well under its 7-day baseline CPL of ~$15.93, so delivery looks healthy.

needs_attention: Ingest gap: no meta-ads run recorded 2026-08-09 through 2026-08-12 (last run in the ledger was 2026-08-08). Per orchestrator instruction this run pulled only yesterday's (2026-08-12) day-bucketed window as normal daily scope rather than widening to backfill the gap, so Meta spend/leads for 2026-08-09 through 2026-08-11 were not captured by this pipeline and are not reflected anywhere.

Campaign 120216224215840296 ("Flooring Problems Campaign") reports lead-like conversions under action types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set: offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, and offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads all showed value=5 yesterday (value=22 in the 7-day baseline), matching lead/onsite_conversion.lead_grouped exactly both times. Didn't change today's leads count (already captured via lead/lead_grouped), but the script's action-type set may need extending to cover these Meta Lead Ads variants explicitly rather than relying on coincidental overlap.
